caption:
Five plugins and Claude Code stops being the thing you ration.

1)OmniRoute for when the limit hits. 237 providers, 90 of them free, and it switches automatically.
2)Claude Mem so it remembers your project instead of asking you every morning.
3)Headroom so you stop burning tokens on noise.
4)Claude Code Setup, official Anthropic, scans your repo and names the hooks, skills and MCP servers you’re missing.
5)Task Observer, which watches how you work and quietly upgrades the rest of your setup.

Install them in that order. Each one fixes the problem the last one creates.
